skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.hunters_gr: A weapon held like it means it. You deal 1 more damage with every attack.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.stake_thru: Straight to the chest. The creature you aim at within 4 blocks takes 5 damage, or 9 if it is undead or a vampire.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.pounce.des: Close the gap. You dash 6 blocks and strike the first creature you reach for 6 damage.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.second_win: Hurt, not beaten. Below half health, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.heartseeke: Find the gap in the ribs. Stake Thrust also deals 9 damage to a slowed creature.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.harry.desc: Never let it settle. Pounce does not stop at the first creature: it strikes up to 3 in its path.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.no_quarter: Nothing walks away. Under a Vow, your quarry glows within 64 blocks, and you deal 50% more damage to it and 50% less to everything else.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.relentless: The hunt carries you. With at least 25 Vigil, you gain Strength.
Your blows burn what should be dead. With at least 50 Vigil, your attacks set undead creatures and vampires on fire.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.final_rite: The last words over the quarry. When Stake Thrust kills, hostile creatures within 8 blocks flee for 5 seconds, and a creature struck by Pounce is held for 2 seconds. Stake Thrust takes 1 second to land.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.stake_read: It will not get far. A creature you hit below 20% health suffers Slowness II for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.fresh_trac: It went this way. The creature you aim at, up to 32 blocks away, glows for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.quarry.des: Never out of sight for long. You gain Speed while a creature you tracked is within 32 blocks.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.vow.descri: That one, and no other. You name the creature you aim at as your quarry for 5 minutes. You deal 25% more damage to it and 25% less to everything else.
skill.townstead.hunter.slayer.trophy.des: The vow is kept. When your quarry dies by your hand, you gain 50 Vigil and 50 stamina, and the Vow ends.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.home_gr: You know every street of it. Inside your village, you gain Resistance.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.sprinkl: A splash of holy water. Holy water pools under hostile creatures within 5 blocks. It burns undead creatures and vampires, and it strips helpful effects from other hostile creatures.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.planted: Nothing moves you off the line. You are knocked back half as far.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.hallowe: Draw the line wider. A Hang Garlic cloud reaches 8 blocks in place of 5.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.incense: Sweet smoke vampires hate. Sprinkle also raises a line of incense 5 blocks wide ahead of you.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.unbroke: The watch does not end at midnight. With at least 25 Vigil at night, you gain Resistance II.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.sunburs: A flash like early morning. Undead creatures and vampires within 8 blocks burn for 5 seconds and are blinded. Other hostile creatures are blinded for 2 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.sanctua: Here, and no further. A Hang Garlic cloud lasts 5 minutes, and Mirror reaches 24 blocks. Each use costs 10 Vigil more.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.last_wa: Where you stand, they cannot rest. With at least 50 Vigil at night, hostile creatures within 10 blocks suffer Garlic.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.false_d: For a moment, the sun comes up. Sunburst burns and blinds undead creatures and vampires for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.thresho: A line they will not cross. While you stand within 2 blocks of a door, undead creatures and vampires within 5 blocks are pushed back.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.hang_ga: A handful of crushed cloves. A garlic cloud hangs where you stand for 60 seconds. Undead creatures and vampires in it suffer Garlic and can barely move.
It shows what is there. Vampires, creatures in a costume and invisible creatures within 12 blocks are shown: they lose Invisibility and glow for 30 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.true_si: Seen, and shaken. A creature shown by Mirror also suffers Weakness for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.nightward.last_li: Light meant for the dead alone. Undead creatures and vampires touched by Sprinkle or Sunburst can barely strike for 5 seconds. Your tools do nothing to the living.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.keen_: You smell them before you see them. At night, hostile creatures within 16 blocks glow.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.mark_: Remember that one. The creature you aim at within 24 blocks is marked and glows for 10 seconds.
Weights on a cord. The creature you aim at within 16 blocks suffers Slowness III for 3 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.light: No twig snaps. At night, you gain Speed.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.calle: It was always going to end here. Every marked creature within 24 blocks takes 5 damage.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.tangl: One throw, two catches. Bola also slows one marked creature within 24 blocks.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.no_es: The trail never goes cold. With at least 25 Vigil, marked creatures within 24 blocks suffer Slowness.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.apex_: Nothing hides from you. With at least 50 Vigil, hostile creatures within 24 blocks are marked.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.the_l: Days on the trail. Creatures marked by Mark Quarry and Read the Trail glow for 60 seconds. Each use costs 10 Vigil more.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.corne: Reel it in. Creatures struck by Called Shot are pulled toward you.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.first: Anything you hurt leaves a trail. When you hit a creature, it is marked.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.pack_: And the ones with it. Mark Quarry also marks creatures within 4 blocks of its target.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.read_: Every bent blade of grass. Every hostile creature within 32 blocks is marked and glows for 10 seconds.
skill.townstead.hunter.trailreader.tally: Count what you found. Read the Trail gives you 2 Vigil for each creature it marks.
The herd is thinned. Called Shot kills a marked creature below 20% health outright, and Bola holds such a creature in place for 6 seconds. Called Shot spends all your Vigil.

story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.title: Oaths
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page1:
First. Come when you are called, whatever the hour.

Second. Wash your hands before, and after.

Third. Speak plainly to the frightened.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page2:
Fourth. Carry the lamp yourself.

Fifth. Keep what you are told.

Sixth. Turn no one away.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page3:
Seventh. Do no harm that you can help.

Eighth. Take nothing from the dying.

Ninth. Do not leave before it is finished.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page4: The quiet one brought his wine again tonight and stood behind my chair until I moved it. She does not like me. I do not think she likes anyone he looks at.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page5: He says I am safe while he is in the house. He has doubled the men at the gate. He sits up when he thinks I am asleep.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page6: If this book comes to anyone but me, give it to my child. Tell them the fourth one is the hardest. Carry the lamp yourself.
story_item.townstead.book_of_oaths.page7: Raining. He is away until the new moon. The quiet one has been kind to me all day, which frightens me more than anything she has done.
